function.name: list_order
function.description: List orders in descending creation time, with optional status/customer filter and pagination by skip/take.

status.description: Optional order status filter. Supported values: Normal, Paid, Unpaid, Canceled.

customerId.description: Optional customer id filter. Only returns orders for the specified customer.

skip.description: Nonnegative integer offset, default 0. Negative values are treated as 0. For the next page, add the number of returned items to skip.

take.description: Nonnegative integer result limit. Omitted or null returns all remaining items; use an explicit budget such as 20 for paging. Zero returns no items; negative values are treated as 0.

sandbox.description: Optional sandbox name. Executes the operation in that sandbox site when provided.
